name: Nathan
overview: Nathan was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Attai according to 1 Chronicles 2:36. While details about his life are limited, his lineage places him within the important tribal context of Judah. No additional personal notes are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Nathan means "gift" and is a proper name recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:36. There is no indication that the name was given directly by God, but it reflects a common Hebrew name within the biblical narrative.
familyAndRelationships: Nathan is explicitly identified as the son of Attai, with Zabad named as his father in 1 Chronicles 2:36. These relationships situate him within a specific family line in the tribe of Judah. Beyond this, Scripture does not record further family connections for Nathan.
scriptureSignificance: Nathan holds significance as a figure rooted in the tribe of Judah, connected through his father Attai. Although the biblical text provides limited direct information about him, his lineage contributes to the broader genealogical record of Judah. His presence in Scripture underscores the importance of family lines in God's unfolding plan.
